title: Filter only owner-authorized Case IDs in synthetic Case Queue picker
goal: Let analysts find a Case within a large server-authorized Case list without re-requesting data, creating a new Case authority, or altering opaque owner-issued Case IDs.
invariants: Case owner remains Investigate; first-party server Case discovery provides the only allowed candidate list.
Only exact, already server-authorized Case IDs may be indexed; no normalization, aliasing or client permission decisions.
Filtering the selector must not change the current Case investigation, create a server request, issue a token, or reveal unapproved Case metadata.
A changed session/bearer or failed/malformed discovery clears every cached selector. No mutation, persistence, Saved View authority, source export or production IAM.
security_properties: Case catalog remains owner-authorized, same-tenant/environment, fail-closed.
Client search cannot turn a denied Case, malformed payload or prior-session selector into a Case option.
Opaque Case IDs with meaningful whitespace are never trimmed; choosing a displayed option transports the original exact value.

migration.rationale: Read-only session-ephemeral Case picker enhancement with no canonical Case schema, backend or durable storage change.

rollback.strategy: Revert this optional selector filtering in the synthetic browser without changing first-party Case discovery or Timeline endpoints.
verification: Original discovery still lists all authorized Cases and picks exact Case IDs
Denied Case data and changed bearer still invalidate cached selector choices

inputs: E10-INV-101F verified bounded Case Queue runtime ownership and Case read requirements
CAP-INV-101 canonical search/filter and Case Queue-to-workspace transition, excluding final Saved Views and lifecycle mutations
Existing authorized GET /demo-cases Case picker backed by first-party Case discovery and HTTP Case owner, plus exact-ID selection in PR #137
outputs: New local literal-ID search input beside the Case picker in synthetic analyst.html
Bounded ephemeral authorized Case list filtered without extra HTTP requests; exact-case identity and session invalidation preserved
Node behavior tests and exact-head GitHub Actions on Linux Go+Node, macOS Go, Windows Go; separate required security gate
acceptance_tests: After a successful owner-authorized catalog response, literal substring selects only authorized IDs and preserves whitespace-distinct Case selectors.
Filtering never generates another network call and never silently changes the current Case; user must explicitly choose a result.
Bearer revocation/in-flight stale response and denied/malformed responses leave zero cached authorized options and disabled filter.
Exact-head runtime and mandatory engineering CI checks are reported independently, without claiming full Case Queue or production acceptance.

performance_budget.rationale: Client-only bounded O(N) pass over at most 5,000 explicitly authorized Case IDs per input; no source fetch or backend filter.
metrics: <=5000 authorized IDs, each <=1024 units; no additional Case discovery request per filter change

definition_of_ready: E10-INV-101F is VERIFIED in current GitHub work graph
First-party owner GET /demo-cases filters unauthorized Candidates prior to response; no OPEN decision needed for local Class-0 filter
Temporary demo picker is an integration adapter, not the permanent Case Queue owner, and only listed allowed paths are modified
definition_of_done: One deterministic session-ephemeral Case filter is integrated into the analyst's actual Case selection workflow
No normalization, authority expansion, hidden network request or stale-token result; Node tests prove boundaries
Exact-head GitHub Actions checked and one distinct risk-based read-only L2 requested if material, with CI, merge and review states separate
